About the author

T.L. Swan

43 books25.1k followers
T L Swan is a #1 Amazon best-selling author and a professional daydream believer. Based on the scenic South Coast of NSW with her husband and three kids, she's seen her books take the romance world by storm with multiple #1 best sellers and translated editions of her books in over 20 languages.

Best known for "The Miles High Club" series, all of her books exist in an inter-connected universe that exudes luxury and desire. Her mission is crafting steamy, tender, and unforgettable romantic stories that stay with you long after you’ve closed the book.

– 3.125 stars

The Stopover Epilogue (Jameson & Emily) ⇝ 3 stars

Jameson and Emily are probably my least favorite couple in this series, but their epilogue was lowkey hilarious. I love the retreat spa idea that Emily had to destress. Seeing Jameson completely out of his elements and throwing tantrums was funny.

“What if there’s an emergency?”
“Tristan will call us here.”
“He knows about this?” he fumes.
“He found this place for me.”
“I’m going to fucking kill him with my bare hands.”


The Takeover Epilogue (Tristan & Claire) ⇝ 4.25 stars

Aww this was so cute. Tristan Miles will always be the best Miles brother there is no competition. Tristan bonding more with the boys was everything, but my favorite part of The Takeover epilogue was when Claire was pregnant and Tristan reading everything about pregnancy. Literally everything related to Claire and pregnancy with Tristan was dlsdksldls 🥰 him having a panic attack bc he doesn’t know what to pack in the bag? Iconic. Tristan being scared that something will happen to Claire during labor? Beautiful. Tristan being the perfect girl dad that he is and never letting his baby girl out of his sight? P E R F E C T I O N.

He blinks back tears. “What?”
“I want you to be the boy’s father.” I smile hopefully. “Legally. Before the baby comes.” I secretly lodged the papers months ago and they have only just been approved. He reads the papers as if unable to believe it and his face screws up in emotion.
“Look what you did, Harry,” Patrick snaps outraged. “He’s crying now because he has to be your father and you’re so naughty. Harry is going to be good from now on, aren’t you, Harry.”


The Casanova Epilogue (Elliot & Kate) ⇝ 3 stars

Well this epilogue was kinda depressing. Most of it dealt with Elliot and Kate fertility issues and didn’t exactly give me warm fuzzy feeling that I wanted for an extended epilogue. Still liked reading it since Elliot and Kate are my 2nd fav after Tristan and Claire. Also that ending was sweet tho.

The Do-Over Epilogue (Christopher & Hayden) ⇝ 2.25 stars

Y’all okay maybe Jameson and Emily are not my least fav couple after all, cause Christopher and Hayden are so boring I can’t. Christopher and Jameson are so similar throwing tantrums when things don’t go their way, but with Christopher I don’t find it funny at all. I’m just not a farm girl at all and couldn’t care less about the cows, dogs, cats and mosquitos and that live there. The best part here was when Eddie and Harry were getting into a fist fight.

Ugh. I’m giving up on TL Swan

This was awful. I forced myself to get thru it. Can someone take pity on TL Swan and be her editor? She needs one BADLY.
There were obvious punctuation mistakes, which anyone who has read her work can attest to. But the dialog was clumsy and cringey.
There’s one person of color and he’s described as magical. Really? Can we escape that racist trope?
I’m pretty certain TL also forgot that most of her characters in this series are American and she wrote very much in her British vernacular the whole time.
Oh, and she compared women to cows. Cool.
Why did I finish this book? Because for as awful as the writing can be, her characters feel real and fun. That’s pretty much it.

This was such a great way to end the series! I loved jumping back into this world and getting an insight into where the characters are years after their books. Reading this has put the idea of a Miles next generation spin off series into my head, which I now desperately want to get my hands on😅

The Stopover:
Their epilogue had me laughing so much. Emily really put Jameson through it in this and I loved it🤣 A very enjoyable read for sure! Their dynamic is so entertaining.

The Takeover:
Along with the Do-Over, I was most excited for this epilogue. I adore Tristan’s relationship with the boys and I loved seeing more of that in this epilogue. Their family is so chaotic and I love it!

The Casanova:
I really felt for Kate and Elliot in this. The majority of their epilogue was them dealing with fertility issues and it was so heartbreaking seeing them go through it. (Not a spoiler as there is a warning before the epilogue) I do wish it were a bit more fluffy, but I did like how real and raw it felt and that it brought awareness to the topic! I did love how it all came together in the end though🥹

The Do-Over:
Christopher and Hayden’s epilogue was so wholesome and funny. I was looking forward to more scenes with Eddie and them together as a family, and I wasn’t disappointed. They were all so sweet together. Also, I am so proud of Eddie and how far his character has come!

Honestly, this was such a disappointment for me.

After reading the original’s and falling for the Miles brothers (unfortunately not their all ladies impressed me), I was so excited for this little foray into their lives after the fact. But the problem was it felt lacking. So I’ll break it down into couples and their stories;

Jameson & Emily ~ this one felt like I was reading about a totally different couple to their original story. Jameson was highly strung, but after their vacay in the first book, he chilled the eff out a tad. Only for this book to tell us he’s gone right back to agitated f**kwit x 1000. Emily was a patronising little whinge and I skipped to the end of it.

Tristan & Claire ~ The two stars are for this one. The standouts in all the books are Claire’s kids, Patrick, Fletcher & Harrison. They were and still are hilarious. Their hi-jinx on the wedding day causes Tristan to be on the brink and honestly I did not stop giggly throughout their story.

Elliott & Kate ~ This was the disappointing one for me. Elliott & Kate’s story, while it should have been moving and emotional, I actually found it out of touch and insensitive.


**SPOILER ALERT**



IVF is a huge thing for many couples, it is majorly expensive and most people struggle to afford one round of treatment let alone 24!! I just found the whole lack of empathy distasteful.


Christopher & Hayden ~ I couldn’t tell you much of this one as I zoned out. What I took from this one is that Eddie found his strength to be who he is, by fighting with Harrison and the Miles brothers all make a toast to their kids who they want to work harder, play harder and f*ck harder (but not the girls) because that’s what we all want for our kids…
This entire review has been hidden because of spoilers.

2.5 stars! Miles Ever After is a collection of novellas, or extended epilogues, for the Miles series. I thought I was looking forward to this, but I was really only looking forward to the catchup with Tristan and Claire (since The Takeover is my fav book in this series). But as a whole, I’m feeling very meh about this whole thing, didn’t really like any of the other novellas besides Tristan & Claire’s. Now obviously fans of the series will love this but for me it just reminded me of why I had disliked certain characters’ books. 😅

The Stopover—Emily and Jameson. He’s been stressed with work, after stopping at his office for a little roleplay-quickie, she makes him take time off. They jet off to Thailand, he thinks for a vacation but she really booked them a wellness retreat. We then jump ahead a few different times (this epilogue covers at least 6 years of time) and see lots of babies in their future.

The Takeover—Claire and Tristan. Starts off with Tristan and Claire’s son Fletcher taking over and starting fresh with Anderson Media. Claire’s pregnant, we see the chaos before their wedding, moving into their new family home, him officially adopting the boys, talking baby names (and his offer of the last name possibility 🥹), he becomes a girl dad, 5 years later and more babies.

The Casanova—Kate and Elliot trying for a baby. CW: tons of fertility, infertility, IVF discussions and journey.

The Do-Over—Hayden and Christopher. Eddie too! Buy a farm house, there’s a big red tractor, I remembered I can’t stand Christopher and the way he talks. 😅 But liked it for Eddie and his journey years later!
